note: Okaloosa County primitive park on the Blackwater River near Baker; hard-packed sand/grass drive-in sites, restrooms/bathhouse + boat ramp; rough but passable gravel/dirt access road. Campers report it free with a 14-day limit and fitting 29-36 ft RVs; the county page states neither. --Claude
